title: Fuel tape setup
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, and let $m$ be either Boolean mode. Choose a host base configuration, an input-head position, a flag tape, a word $w$, and an output word. Starting in phase $0$ with an empty counter tape, payload tape storing $w$, counter head at zero, and payload head at $|w|$, the loop host reaches phase $4$ after $3|w|+4$ steps, with the counter tape storing $w$, the payload tape blank, and both heads at zero; the other specified components are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean finite Turing machines B and F
